Multiple‑match handling sides: Arguments mult.x mult.y specify handle multiple matches either sides, including semi‑ anti‑joins. High performance: Uses advanced internal “cookbook” data.table join recipes efficiently casts inputs outputs speed memory-efficiency. Lightweight dependency: Depends data.table, mature, dependency‑free package long-term stability.
